note: Same 2 ms attack, but the onset is deliberately placed so that for the 2048-sample / 44.1 kHz window it falls within a few samples of an analysis-window boundary (onset at sample 9728 = 19 hops of 512). This is the case that exposes onset compensation: a window that must straddle the attack can pull the perceived attack either side of the true position. Add variants to probe other windows and rates.
